items.q: the band I worked with here, was Marcelino Guerrero, I was just going up as a substitute

ctx.x: But, the band I worked with here, was Marcelino Guerrero, I was just going up as a substitute, you know, and I didn't care too much about it at all. Because the band was a great band, but it didn't -- move me.
This was in the '40's, in what, '46, '7?
